name: Josh Harder

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NUTRIA ERADICATION AND CONTROL REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NUTRIA ERADICATION AND CONTROL REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: My bill would reauthorize funding to strengthen eradication efforts for the invasive swamp rats, nutria, which are destroying our levees, harming local farmland, and infecting our very drinking water.
Last year, more than 1,300 nutria were captured in California, which is a record-breaking year for takings in the State.

Madam Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, the Nutria Eradication and Control Reauthorization Act of 2025, because communities in California and across the country are in a war right now against these giant swamp rats.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to pass my bill to stop this infestation from poisoning our waterways and damaging our communities.
